item.title: Attorney General Ellison pushes back on Postal Service’s attempt to undermine voting rights
item.description:
Publication Date: July 02, 2026

Joins coalition of 24 AGs in filing letter opposing USPS’s attempt to restrict mail-in voting and aid Trump’s unprecedented efforts to seize control of elections, and asking USPS to drop its proposed rule

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/07/02_USPS.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins court order to protect dogs from apparent poisoning attempt in Mankato
item.description:
Publication Date: July 03, 2026

Ellison sues two Mankato residents for allegedly placing rodenticides on sidewalk in attempt to deter dogs from urinating on their lawn, in violation of state and federal law strictly regulating their use

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/07/03_Rat-Poison.asp
